affinity.notes: Saturated luminous green and pervasive bubbling strongly code poison or acid affinity.

anatomy.notes: The amorphous body, pooled lobes, tendrils, and embedded eyes form a clear slime anatomy.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "hazardous area-denial ooze" does not semantically communicate Multicore Tide Sovereign (Sovereign) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Bubbling surface and spreading base visibly warn against close contact and standing nearby.

finish.notes: Translucency, bubbles, drips, and embedded forms are polished and materially consistent.

framing.notes: The broad base and complete upper dome fit centrally with a clean silhouette.

identity.notes: Blind perception "toxic many-eyed slime" semantically identifies slimes/slime-primordial-ooze.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "normal" is outside the accepted set for intended T5.
